summary: Equity LifeStyle Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) solely to announce a regular quarterly dividend declaration. The Board declared a Q3 2026 dividend of $0.5425 per common share ($2.17 annualized), payable October 9, 2026, to holders of record on September 25, 2026. There are no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist, or structural change elements. The filing includes customary forward-looking language about business risks. No special-situation catalyst or event is present; this is a routine capital-return disclosure.
